# Outbound OS

> Outbound OS is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted WhatsApp CRM and outreach platform. It captures leads from website forms, Facebook Lead Ads, IndiaMART and any webhook, contacts each lead on WhatsApp, email, Telegram or iMessage within seconds, runs follow-ups that stop when the lead replies, and keeps the conversation, pipeline, orders and invoices on one lead record. It runs with one Docker Compose command and includes an MCP server so Claude and other AI clients can work the CRM.

Key facts:

- License: AGPL-3.0. Free for any use, including commercial. No paid tier; optional managed hosting by the maintainers.
- Source: https://github.com/thatsarpit/outbound-os
- Stack: Node.js 24, Express, Prisma, SQLite; React dashboard; Docker Compose.
- WhatsApp: Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API directly, or AiSensy, chosen per number. It never automates the WhatsApp phone apps. Meta bills messages (templates, and from 1 October 2026 service replies) to the user's own WhatsApp Business account; Outbound OS adds no markup.
- Not included: chatbot builder, Instagram DMs, click-to-WhatsApp ad tools.

## Docs

- [Install with Docker](https://outboundos.space/docs/install): requirements, first admin, setup wizard, HTTPS
- [Configuration reference](https://outboundos.space/docs/configuration): every .env setting
- [Connect the WhatsApp Cloud API](https://outboundos.space/docs/whatsapp-cloud-api): Meta app, permanent token, webhook, first-contact template
- [Website forms and lead webhooks](https://outboundos.space/docs/website-forms): addresses, keys, field names, test mode
- [Set up the MCP server](https://outboundos.space/docs/mcp): tokens, Claude Code, claude.ai connector
- [Backups, restores and upgrades](https://outboundos.space/docs/backups-and-upgrades)
